title: Hoshino Ichika — A Different Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Jam Fest was so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's a little sad to think that it's all over.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Now that things have calmed down, I feel a bit restless...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you free right now, Ichika?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? You're all here?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I'm free. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Nothing's wrong...
We hadn't congratulated you girls on the festival yet, is all.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We haven't had much chance to talk since it ended.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right. That's why you're all here.
Thanks for coming out of your way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No thanks needed. We just wanted to be sure we said it.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Huh? Were you working on something just now, Ichika?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You have your tablet with you.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, this...?
I was just thinking about reading everyone's thoughts regarding the festival.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Some people there saw us play for the very first time, so I was hoping to hear their opinions.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, it would be nice to hear their thoughts.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The audience did seem to have a lot of fun, it felt like.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. You all seemed very excited during your performance.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, did it show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, you all looked like you were having a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, Ichika, can we see what everyone thought with you?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Let's see... What if I set up my phone like this here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you. Alright, what did everyone have to say?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, a lot of people seem to have written comments.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
“Leo/need's that cider band?”
“I know this Leo/need song! It's from that commercial!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, look at this one.
“So glad I got to hear the song from that commercial live.”>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's incredible how much reach commercials have.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's pretty huge that people who haven't seen your live house performances are listening to your song.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, not only are they talking about the cider song, some are talking about your other songs.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, like these...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
“The song from the commercial was good, but so are their other songs!”
“I think I liked one of them more than the cider song. But what was it called?” I wonder which song they're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Your song is getting people interested in the rest of your band's catalog, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <This person also said something really kind.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kind? Let me see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “I couldn't help but smile after seeing them have so much fun as they played. I really like their music. I haven't heard anything that felt so honest and straightforward in such a long time...!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. How do you feel?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A little embarrassed.
But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier about people feeling this way after stopping by and watching our performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Good thing you all practiced so hard for it, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad we did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That said, maybe it's weird to feel this way right after a big performance, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What's wrong?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel like doing another show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then, why don't you come over to SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <If you feel like singing, then I'll play with you.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, if you'll join me...
